title: Cipher and Ledger
author: Ada Iversen
blurb: Lena Eriksen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
